transcript: OpenAI just launched Astra, and it's better than Claude in every way, except one that actually matters. Like nothing is better than this. Tum jitne bhi benchmarks abhi dekh rahe ho, un sab mein Astra is better than Claude. But the one thing that OpenAI didn't expose is when it comes to actual coding, Claude abhi bhi best hai with its Fable 5.1. Tum yahan dekh sakte ho ek independent tester ne ek benchmark nikala where Astra scored 67, Claude scored 70 and beats it. But there's more to it. OpenAI made it so good at finding loopholes that it can hack any system right now, but obviously that's out of your range because it can be misused easily. To agar tumhe ek AI chahiye that do your tasks better than you, you should choose Astra. But if you are still shipping real codes, Claude code is better. Aur agar tumhe poore benchmark ka breakdown chahiye so that you know when to use which AI model, then comment me down below and I'll send you the link.
